body: Fixed upstream 2026-10-13: voltkit versioncmd v0.1.0/v0.2.0 required a nonexistent voltkit/output v0.0.0 (a workspace replace leaked into its published go.mod); agx built only because it required output directly (MVS picked the real version). versioncmd v0.2.1 requires output v0.2.0 with no replace, and agx moved to github.com/ubgo/voltkit/... in 8b8877a. The direct output require is now ordinary use (--json envelope), not a workaround.
